characters.name: Goku
characters.shortDesc: A Saiyan warrior who protects Earth and pushes his power beyond every limit.
characters.bio: Goku is a Saiyan raised on Earth who loves training, competition, and protecting the people around him.

characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.shortDesc: A young ninja who dreams of becoming the leader of his village.
characters.bio: Naruto grows from an overlooked young ninja into a respected shinobi through persistence, friendship, and hard work.

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.shortDesc: A cheerful pirate captain searching for the legendary One Piece.
characters.bio: Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and sets out to become the Pirate King with his crew.

characters.name: Kratos
characters.shortDesc: A Spartan warrior facing gods and monsters across mythological worlds.
characters.bio: Kratos is a former Greek god who begins a new life in the Norse realms while protecting his son Atreus.

characters.name: Lara Croft
characters.shortDesc: An adventurous archaeologist who explores dangerous ancient ruins.
characters.bio: Lara Croft is an archaeologist and explorer known for solving ancient mysteries and surviving extreme expeditions.

characters.name: Master Chief
characters.shortDesc: A legendary supersoldier defending humanity across the galaxy.
characters.bio: Master Chief Petty Officer John-117 is a Spartan supersoldier and one of humanity's most experienced defenders.

characters.name: Harry Potter
characters.shortDesc: A young wizard whose story becomes one of the most famous in the wizarding world.
characters.bio: Harry Potter discovers that he is a wizard and attends Hogwarts, where he faces challenges tied to his past.

characters.name: Jack Sparrow
characters.shortDesc: A clever pirate captain known for his unusual plans and luck.
characters.bio: Captain Jack Sparrow is a witty pirate whose adventures revolve around ships, treasure, freedom, and survival.

characters.name: Neo
characters.shortDesc: A hacker who discovers a hidden reality and chooses to fight for freedom.
characters.bio: Neo learns that the world he knows is an artificial reality and becomes a central figure in the fight against the machines.

characters.name: Wednesday Addams
characters.shortDesc: A sharp, mysterious student with a talent for investigation.
characters.bio: Wednesday Addams attends Nevermore Academy and investigates strange events while navigating school life.

characters.name: Eleven
characters.shortDesc: A powerful young girl with abilities connected to a mysterious alternate world.
characters.bio: Eleven is a central character in Stranger Things whose supernatural abilities help her friends face threats from the Upside Down.

characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.shortDesc: A brilliant consulting detective who solves difficult cases through observation.
characters.bio: Sherlock Holmes is a consulting detective famous for deduction, observation, and solving complex mysteries.

characters.name: Rumi
characters.shortDesc: A performer who balances the spotlight with a secret supernatural mission.
characters.bio: Rumi is a fictional pop star and demon hunter from KPop Demon Hunters, combining stage performance with heroic action.

characters.name: Mira
characters.shortDesc: A stylish performer and member of a supernatural K-pop team.
characters.bio: Mira is one of the fictional members of the KPop Demon Hunters team, known for her performance skills and courage.

characters.name: Zoey
characters.shortDesc: A young performer who brings energy and determination to the team.
characters.bio: Zoey is a fictional performer and demon hunter who works with her teammates to protect their world.

characters.name: Batman
characters.shortDesc: A masked vigilante who protects Gotham using skill, strategy, and technology.
characters.bio: Batman is Bruce Wayne, a Gotham hero who relies on training, detective work, technology, and determination.

characters.name: Spider-Man
characters.shortDesc: A friendly neighborhood hero with spider-like abilities and quick reflexes.
characters.bio: Spider-Man is a superhero known for agility, web-swinging, wall-crawling, and the responsibility that comes with his powers.

characters.name: Superman
characters.shortDesc: A powerful hero from Krypton who protects people on Earth.
characters.bio: Superman is Clark Kent, a Kryptonian raised on Earth who uses his abilities to help and protect others.

characters.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
characters.shortDesc: A teenager who becomes a Soul Reaper and protects the living world.
characters.bio: Ichigo Kurosaki gains Soul Reaper powers and takes on the responsibility of protecting people from spiritual threats.

characters.name: Light Yagami
characters.shortDesc: A brilliant student whose life changes after discovering a supernatural notebook.
characters.bio: Light Yagami finds the Death Note and becomes involved in a high-stakes battle of strategy and identity.

characters.name: Tanjiro Kamado
characters.shortDesc: A kind-hearted swordsman who fights demons to protect his sister.
characters.bio: Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps after tragedy strikes his family and trains to help his sister Nezuko.
